results.question: Which region generated the most revenue?
results.generated_sql:
WITH revenue_summary AS (
    SELECT c.region, SUM(o.quantity * p.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100)) AS total_revenue
    FROM customers c
    JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE oi.quantity > 0
    GROUP BY c.region
)
SELECT r.region, rs.total_revenue
FROM revenue_summary rs
JOIN customers c ON rs.region = c.region
ORDER BY rs.total_revenue DESC
